ledeEn: Curfews in France, attacks on Saudi Arabia and a scramble to secure the web: the week’s events, followed by the reporting that helps explain them.
lede: 法国局部宵禁、沙特持续遇袭、互联网紧急修补漏洞：先交代本周事件，再读解释其来龙去脉的报道。
observationEn: The cost of insecurity reaches beyond the battlefield: into borrowing, public services and the infrastructure of everyday life.
observation: 不安全的代价并不限于战场，也进入借贷、公共服务和日常基础设施。
scopeEn: October 19–25, selected from the supplied newspapers and magazines. October 17 riots are background to this week’s response. The supplied reporting closes before the October 25 election results; those results and their aftermath appear in the following edition. Original bilingual summaries, not full translations.
scope: 选自所提供日报与杂志，报道窗口为10月19–25日。10月17日骚乱作为本周应对措施的背景。所提供报道截稿早于10月25日选举结果，结果及后续见下一期。内容为原创双语摘要，不是全文翻译。
readingNoteEn: Read the Gulf rivalry briefing, the FT’s comparison of China and Japan, and the Journal’s investigation of autism-therapy billing. Reading times refer to the English originals.
readingNote: 精读依次推荐海湾竞争、FT中日经济比较及自闭症治疗收费调查。分钟数为英文原文预计阅读时间。

briefs.titleEn: France Imposes Local Curfews After Riots
briefs.titleZh: 骚乱之后，法国实施局部宵禁
briefs.summaryEn: French authorities imposed curfews in parts of several cities after the October 17 riots, and promised a much larger police presence for the next demonstrations. The protests began over education and living costs; violent groups and looters joined them. Macron rejected claims that migrants were responsible. French government bonds sold off as the unrest compounded concern about the budget.
briefs.summaryZh: 10月17日骚乱后，法国在多个城市的部分地区实施宵禁，并承诺为下一轮示威大幅增派警力。抗议最初针对教育和生活成本，随后有暴力团体和抢劫者加入。马克龙反驳将骚乱归咎于移民的说法。动荡加重预算担忧，法国国债遭到抛售。
briefs.why: 宵禁与警力部署会改变公民集会空间；安全措施能否止暴而不扩大对立，关系法国社会与财政稳定。
briefs.source: FT · OCT 20, 22–23 · PP. 1, 4; THE ECONOMIST · OCT 24 · PP. 41–42

briefs.titleEn: Saudi Investment Summit Postponed as Attacks Continue
briefs.titleZh: 袭击持续，沙特投资峰会延期
briefs.summaryEn: Saudi Arabia postponed its major investment conference until 2027 amid Houthi airstrikes, the Journal reported. The FT reported two deaths in a drone strike targeting the Shaybah oilfield and a US order for some government staff and families to leave the kingdom. Britain announced a defensive deployment of fighter jets. These are signs of widening disruption, not evidence that a regional ceasefire has been reached.
briefs.summaryZh: 《华尔街日报》报道，胡塞武装空袭之下，沙特将重要投资会议推迟至2027年。FT报道，针对谢拜油田的无人机袭击造成两人死亡，美国下令部分政府工作人员及家属离开沙特。英国宣布部署战机执行防御任务。这些是冲击扩大的信号，不代表地区已经停火。
briefs.why: 袭击正在把地区冲突转化为出行和投资风险，可能冲击能源供应及沙特经济转型。
briefs.source: WSJ · OCT 20 · A1; FT · OCT 21, 23 · PP. 1, 4

briefs.titleEn: WFP Cuts Gaza Food Support as Funding Runs Short
briefs.titleZh: 资金短缺，世界粮食计划署削减加沙粮援
briefs.summaryEn: The World Food Programme said funding shortages were forcing cuts to assistance for 500,000 people in Gaza. The FT reported smaller food parcels and a reduction in hot meals as winter approached. The agency warned that fragile gains in food security were at risk. The affected population is not a death toll, and this funding decision is distinct from restrictions on physical access.
briefs.summaryZh: 世界粮食计划署表示，资金短缺迫使其削减对加沙50万人口的援助。FT报道，临近冬季，食品包缩小、热餐减少。该机构警告，粮食安全的脆弱改善面临风险。受影响人口不是死亡人数，这项资金决定也不同于物资实体准入限制。
briefs.why: 粮食援助缩减会直接削弱脆弱家庭的生存保障；资金缺口也可能使人道危机进一步恶化。

briefs.titleEn: Deadly Drone Strikes Add to Sudan’s Civilian Toll
briefs.titleZh: 苏丹无人机袭击再添平民伤亡
briefs.summaryEn: The Economist reported more than 80 deaths in a drone strike near a market in southern Sudan and at least 150 in a separate strike in a disputed border region. The RSF blamed the army. These were separate reported incidents, not a verified combined weekly death toll; access and independent verification remain difficult.
briefs.summaryZh: 《经济学人》报道，苏丹南部市场附近一次无人机袭击造成80多人死亡，争议边境地区另一场袭击造成至少150人死亡。快速支援部队指责苏丹军方。这是分别报道的事件，不能当作已独立核实的全周死亡总数；现场进入和独立核验仍然困难。
briefs.why: 无人机扩大了战争伤及平民的范围，可能加剧流离失所，并增加人道救援的难度。

briefs.titleZh: 威特科夫会见普京后，俄军继续袭击
briefs.summaryEn: US envoy Steve Witkoff met Vladimir Putin, and Russia released American detainee Stephen Hubbard. But Russian missiles subsequently struck Kyiv, killing two and injuring more than 50, Ukrainian authorities said. Zelensky said some missiles carried cluster warheads. Proposals for further talks had not produced a ceasefire; the attacks are an essential part of the diplomatic story.
briefs.summaryZh: 美国特使威特科夫会见普京，俄罗斯释放美国被拘押者斯蒂芬·哈伯德。但随后俄军导弹袭击基辅，乌克兰当局称两人死亡、50多人受伤。泽连斯基称部分导弹携带集束弹头。后续谈判设想并未产生停火，袭击是这条外交新闻不可缺少的部分。
briefs.why: 谈判并未阻止袭击，说明外交接触不等于降级；平民安全和能源设施仍取决于可执行的约束。
briefs.source: FT · OCT 22 · PP. 1, 4; OCT 23 · P. 4; WSJ · OCT 22 · A8

briefs.titleEn: Italy Sends Soldiers to Milan After Unrest
briefs.titleZh: 意大利在动荡后向米兰增派军人
briefs.summaryEn: Italy announced that 500 soldiers would be sent to Milan after cost-of-living protests were followed by vandalism and looting. Officials also discussed tougher public-order measures, including rules affecting minors. The Guardian distinguished people detained from those formally arrested; the figures are not interchangeable.
briefs.summaryZh: 生活成本抗议随后出现破坏和抢劫，意大利宣布向米兰增派500名军人。官员还讨论更严厉的治安措施，包括涉及未成年人的规定。《卫报》区分了被扣留者与正式被捕者，两种数字不能混用。
briefs.why: 动用军队应对社会骚乱，会改变公共秩序治理的边界，也考验政府能否回应抗议背后的压力。

briefs.titleEn: Alberta Rejects a Further Step Towards Separation
briefs.titleZh: 艾伯塔选民否决进一步推动分离
briefs.summaryEn: More than three-quarters of Alberta voters opposed holding a referendum on leaving Canada, according to the FT’s reported count. The non-binding vote did not itself decide independence. It reduced the immediate momentum behind separation while leaving disputes over provincial powers unresolved.
briefs.summaryZh: 按FT报道的计票情况，超过四分之三艾伯塔选民反对就脱离加拿大举行公投。这次不具约束力的投票本身并非独立公投。它削弱了分离运动的即时动力，但没有解决省权争议。
briefs.why: 分离诉求关系加拿大的能源、税收与联邦权力分配；程序性投票与独立本身会带来不同风险。

briefs.titleEn: China Reports 4.5% Growth, With Demand Still Uneven
briefs.titleZh: 中国公布4.5%增长，需求仍不均衡
briefs.summaryEn: China reported third-quarter growth of 4.5% from a year earlier. Exports remained a support while the property downturn and weak household spending weighed on demand. The headline measures total output, not the experience of every household, and should not be confused with a quarter-on-quarter annualised rate.
briefs.summaryZh: 中国公布第三季度经济同比增长4.5%。出口仍提供支撑，房地产下行和家庭消费疲弱则拖累需求。总量指标不代表每个家庭的感受，也不能与环比折年率混为一谈。
briefs.why: 出口与内需分化，会影响就业、家庭收入及政策空间，也可能增加贸易伙伴的竞争压力。
briefs.source: WSJ · OCT 19 · A10; THE ECONOMIST · OCT 24 · P. 6

briefs.summaryEn: The Nasdaq fell 2.6% on October 22 as investors reassessed technology companies’ financing needs, the Journal reported. Attention shifted from rapid revenue growth to cash generation, debt and expensive infrastructure commitments. A daily sell-off is evidence of repricing, not proof that the entire technology industry is insolvent.
briefs.summaryZh: 《华尔街日报》报道，投资者重新评估科技公司的融资需求，纳斯达克指数10月22日下跌2.6%。关注点从营收高速增长转向现金创造、债务及昂贵的基础设施承诺。单日下跌意味着风险重估，并不能证明整个科技行业资不抵债。
briefs.why: AI扩张越来越依赖融资；投资者一旦重估偿债能力，压力可能从科技股传向信贷与实体投资。

briefs.titleEn: UK Inflation Rises Before the Budget
briefs.titleZh: 预算前夕，英国通胀回升
briefs.summaryEn: UK annual inflation rose to 3.5% in September from 3.1%, adding pressure on households ahead of the October 28 budget. Government borrowing also exceeded forecasts. Expectations of a future Bank of England rate increase remained expectations, not a policy decision made this week.
briefs.summaryZh: 英国9月同比通胀由3.1%升至3.5%，在10月28日预算前加重家庭压力。政府借款也超出预测。市场对英格兰银行未来加息的预期仍是预期，不是本周已经作出的决定。
briefs.why: 能源推动物价上涨，会同时侵蚀购买力并限制降息空间，使家庭与政府更难平衡收支。
briefs.source: THE GUARDIAN · OCT 22 · PP. 1, 14; THE ECONOMIST · OCT 24 · P. 6

briefs.titleEn: Covid Inquiry Finds Care Homes Were Not Protected
briefs.titleZh: 新冠调查认定养老院未获应有保护
briefs.summaryEn: The UK Covid inquiry’s adult-social-care report rejected the claim that a protective ring had been placed around care homes. It criticised failures on isolation advice and protective equipment, and recommended better planning and safeguards for visiting. The report examines pandemic-era decisions; publication this week does not make those deaths new fatalities.
briefs.summaryZh: 英国新冠调查的成人社会照护报告否定了养老院受到‘保护圈’保障的说法，批评隔离建议和防护装备不足，并建议改进规划、保障探视。报告调查的是疫情时期的决策，本周发布不意味着这些死亡发生在本周。
briefs.why: 养老院防护失灵暴露机构间责任缺口；调查建议能否落实，决定下次公共卫生危机是否重演。

links.note: Web version may include later updates · 网页版可能含后续更新

briefs.titleEn: Ofcom Finds Little Change in Children’s Exposure to Harm
briefs.titleZh: Ofcom评估发现儿童有害内容接触比例变化不大
briefs.summaryEn: An Ofcom review of the first nine months of new online-safety requirements found no significant change in the proportion of children encountering harmful content, the Guardian reported. Campaigners demanded stronger action. The finding concerns measured exposure, not proof that every safety measure had no effect or that every child had the same experience.
briefs.summaryZh: 《卫报》报道，Ofcom评估新的网络安全要求实施前九个月，发现接触有害内容的儿童比例没有显著变化。倡议团体要求更强行动。结论针对被测量的接触比例，并不证明每项安全措施都无效，也不表示每个儿童经历相同。
briefs.why: 法律出台不代表儿童已更安全；有害内容暴露是否下降，才是检验平台责任与监管成效的关键。

briefs.titleEn: Critical PHP Flaws Trigger an Emergency Patch Race
briefs.titleZh: PHP严重漏洞引发紧急修补
briefs.summaryEn: Organisations raced to secure websites after critical PHP vulnerabilities were disclosed. Some government sites went offline while fixes were prepared. The Economist described a wider cluster of security incidents and the danger of releasing exploit details before patches are available. Exposure to a flaw is not confirmation that a particular site was successfully hacked.
briefs.summaryZh: PHP严重漏洞披露后，各机构紧急保护网站，部分政府网站在等待修复时下线。《经济学人》将其置于一系列安全事件中，指出补丁就绪前泄露利用细节的危险。存在漏洞不等于某个网站已经遭到成功入侵。
briefs.why: 广泛使用的软件漏洞可能同时影响公共服务与商业系统，修补速度决定风险能否被及时控制。
briefs.source: WSJ · OCT 22 · A1; FT · OCT 23 · P. 10; THE ECONOMIST · OCT 24 · P. 75

topics.title: The petty feud wrecking a region
topics.titleZh: 一场破坏地区的海湾争斗
topics.author: The Economist correspondents
topics.summaryEn: Saudi Arabia and the UAE face common threats but support competing partners around the Red Sea. In Yemen their divided anti-Houthi camp has weakened; in Sudan the article traces Emirati support for the RSF, which the UAE denies, and Saudi backing for the army. Port access, trade and ambitions for regional leadership overlap with personal rivalry. The briefing argues that these interventions prolong wars whose local causes remain distinct.
topics.summaryZh: 沙特与阿联酋面临共同威胁，却在红海周边支持相互竞争的伙伴。也门反胡塞阵营因此削弱；在苏丹，文章追溯阿联酋对快速支援部队的支持——阿联酋对此否认——及沙特对军方的支持。港口、贸易和地区领导权诉求与个人竞争交织。报道认为，这些干预延长了战争，但各国战争仍有不同的本土根源。
topics.backgroundEn: This week’s Saudi attacks and conference postponement show the immediate cost of regional insecurity. The briefing supplies a longer history, rather than claiming every conflict began this week.
topics.backgroundZh: 本周沙特遇袭和会议延期呈现地区不安全的即时成本。这篇报道提供更长的历史，并非声称各场战争始于本周。
argumentEn: Shared threats have not produced a shared Gulf strategy.
Competing local allies can turn mediation into another arena of rivalry.
Outside reconciliation might reduce the violence, but cannot by itself resolve local conflicts.
argumentZh: 共同威胁没有带来共同的海湾战略。
竞争性地方盟友使调停也可能成为争夺舞台。
外部和解可能减少暴力，但不能独自解决本土冲突。
topics.evidenceEn: The report combines conflict histories, diplomatic accounts and patterns of backing for rival forces. Covert support is harder to verify than public deployments; denial and uncertainty must remain visible. Its regional causal argument is an interpretation, not an estimate of how many deaths each outside power caused.
topics.evidenceZh: 报道结合冲突史、外交人士叙述及支持对立武装的模式。秘密支持比公开部署更难核实，须保留否认和不确定性。其地区因果框架是解释，不是各外部势力造成死亡人数的测算。
topics.why: 沙特与阿联酋的竞争可能延长苏丹、也门等地冲突，把地区权力争夺转化为持续的人道与安全代价。
topics.limits: 海湾视角不能代替苏丹及也门当事人的全部经验；隐蔽行动证据有局限。
topics.perspective: 日报交代袭击及商业影响；这篇区域分析强调盟友之间的竞争，两者不能互相替代。

topics.title: The collapse of reason
topics.titleZh: 法国动荡：秩序与代表性的双重危机
topics.author: The Economist correspondents
topics.summaryEn: After the October 17 violence, France introduced partial curfews and prepared heavier security. The report separates peaceful students and unionists, organised violent groups and opportunistic looters. It connects the crisis to education, living costs and an approaching presidential election. Its claim that political extremes may gain is an assessment, not an election result, and blaming migrants as a group is not supported by the reporting.
topics.summaryZh: 10月17日暴力之后，法国实施局部宵禁并准备加强安保。报道区分和平学生与工会示威者、有组织暴力团体以及趁机抢劫者，将危机连接到教育、生活成本和临近的总统选举。政治极端势力可能得利是分析判断，不是选举结果；将移民群体整体归罪也不受报道支持。
topics.backgroundEn: The unrest began before this edition’s window. This week’s story is the government response, the contest over its meaning and the interaction with fragile public finances.
topics.backgroundZh: 骚乱起于本期窗口之前。本周重点是政府应对、解释权争夺，以及动荡与脆弱财政之间的相互作用。
argumentEn: Violence can obscure the demands of peaceful protesters.
A public-order failure can become a wider crisis of political credibility.
Claims about electoral beneficiaries need to be tested against later results.
argumentZh: 暴力可能遮蔽和平示威者的诉求。
治安失灵可能演变为更广泛的政治信誉危机。
关于谁在选举中获益的推断须由后续结果检验。
topics.evidenceEn: On-the-ground scenes, police figures, polling and accounts of online disinformation support different parts of the story. Arrests are not convictions; polls are snapshots. The FT’s bond reporting adds a market channel, while the Guardian gives more space to policing and protesters’ grievances.
topics.evidenceZh: 现场描述、警方数字、民调及网络虚假信息记录分别支持不同层面的叙述。被捕不等于定罪，民调只是时点快照。FT补充债券市场渠道，《卫报》更重视警务方式和抗议诉求。
topics.why: 骚乱可能强化政治极端力量；公共安全与抗议权如何平衡，将影响法国政策选择和社会信任。
topics.limits: 不能以暴力者代表所有示威者，也不能把民调变动当成已确定政治转向。
topics.perspective: 三刊对秩序、经济困境和警务责任的强调不同，保留这些差异。

topics.title: Where credit’s due
topics.author: The Economist correspondents
topics.summaryEn: AI infrastructure is increasingly financed by borrowing rather than the established technology groups’ cash flows alone. Neocloud providers, large platforms, chip firms and financing vehicles share exposure to a small set of customers and expectations. Falling bond prices and rising insurance costs show investors becoming less comfortable with that structure. They do not establish that defaults are inevitable.
topics.summaryZh: AI基础设施越来越依靠借款，而不只是成熟科技公司的现金流。新型云服务商、大平台、芯片企业和融资载体共同暴露于少数客户及相似预期。债券价格下跌、违约保险成本上升，显示投资者对这种结构愈发不安，但不能据此断言违约必然发生。
topics.backgroundEn: The week’s stock sell-off and FT reporting on default protection make the financing chain a current news question, not simply a prediction about future technology.
topics.backgroundZh: 本周股市抛售和FT关于违约保护的报道，使融资链成为当下新闻问题，而不只是技术未来预测。
argumentEn: Trace who owes money to whom, not only who reports growing sales.
Long infrastructure commitments can outlast uncertain customer demand.
Useful technology and profitable investments are different propositions.
argumentZh: 不仅看销售增长，还要追踪谁欠谁的钱。
长期基础设施承诺可能超过客户需求的可预测期限。
技术有用和投资有利可图是两个命题。
topics.evidenceEn: Balance-sheet aggregates and bond prices illuminate leverage. A default probability inferred from swaps is model-dependent, not a literal forecast. Different publications count different parts of AI-related debt, so their totals should not be added together.
topics.evidenceZh: 资产负债表汇总和债券价格揭示杠杆。由掉期推导的违约概率依赖模型，并非直观预测。各刊统计的AI相关债务范围不同，不能直接相加。
topics.why: AI债务把未来收入预期变成今天的还款责任；需求不及预期时，风险可能传向信贷与就业。
topics.limits: 融资风险与技术能力无一一对应关系；市场价格会迅速变化。

topics.title: Two Asian giants, one economic trap
topics.titleZh: 两个亚洲巨人，一道经济陷阱？
topics.author: Joe Leahy and Leo Lewis
topics.summaryEn: The FT compares China after its property downturn with Japan after its bubble burst: weak confidence, debt repayment, ageing and deflation can reinforce each other. But the comparison is disputed. China is less developed, retains competitive manufacturing and exports, and has different policy constraints. Economists disagree about the scale and composition of stimulus needed. The article asks whether these differences can prevent stagnation; it does not establish that China must repeat Japan’s lost decades.
topics.summaryZh: FT比较房地产下行后的中国与泡沫破裂后的日本：信心疲弱、偿债、老龄化和通缩可能相互强化。但类比存在争议。中国发展水平较低，仍有竞争性制造业和出口，政策约束也不同。经济学家对刺激的规模与构成看法不一。文章追问这些差异能否避免停滞，而不是证明中国必然重演日本失去的几十年。
topics.backgroundEn: China’s reported 4.5% year-on-year third-quarter growth makes the contrast between headline output and household caution timely. Japanification describes a possible economic pattern, not a formal diagnosis or a certainty.
topics.backgroundZh: 中国公布第三季度同比增长4.5%，使总量产出与家庭谨慎之间的反差具有当下意义。‘日本化’描述可能的经济模式，不是正式诊断或确定命运。
argumentEn: Balance-sheet repair can suppress demand even when interest rates fall.
Strong exports and manufacturing distinguish China from post-bubble Japan.
The relevant question is which policies repair household confidence and demand.
argumentZh: 即使利率下降，修复资产负债表也可能压低需求。
强出口和制造业使中国不同于泡沫后的日本。
关键问题是哪些政策能修复家庭信心与需求。
topics.evidenceEn: The report combines economic series, household interviews and competing economists’ explanations. Its Japanification index is a composite indicator, not proof of causation. Forecasts about overtaking the US depend on exchange rates and growth assumptions; they are not established outcomes.
topics.evidenceZh: 报道结合经济序列、家庭采访和不同经济学家的解释。‘日本化指数’是综合指标，不是因果证明。关于赶超美国的预测取决于汇率及增长假设，不是既定结果。
topics.why: 中国与日本都面临内需不足的挑战，但政策与人口差异决定相似症状是否会走向相同结果。
topics.limits: 历史类比有选择性；不能用单个指数断言未来几十年的增长轨迹。
topics.perspective: FT提供多方宏观争论，WSJ家庭报道补充居民经验，两者都不能独自代表全体家庭。

topics.title: Autism Therapy’s ‘Business Math’
topics.titleZh: 自闭症治疗的‘商业算术’
topics.author: Anna Wilde Mathews, Christopher Weaver and Tom McGinty
topics.summaryEn: The Journal analysed Medicaid billing by five large private-equity-backed autism-therapy providers. Four billed more weekly hours than local competitors; its comparison of some children switching providers also found changes in treatment hours. Families and former staff described pressure around intensive schedules. The companies said care was individualised and argued that billing comparisons miss severity, quality and clinical need. More billed hours alone do not prove unnecessary treatment.
topics.summaryZh: 《华尔街日报》分析五家大型私募股权支持的自闭症治疗机构Medicaid账单，发现其中四家每周收费时数高于当地竞争者；部分转院儿童的比较也显示治疗时数变化。家庭和前员工描述密集排期的压力。机构称治疗因人而异，认为账单比较遗漏病情严重度、质量和临床需要。收费时数多本身不能证明治疗不必要。
topics.backgroundEn: The investigation asks how payment per treatment hour interacts with clinical decisions and families’ wishes, including school attendance. It is reporting about incentives, not advice to alter a child’s care.
topics.backgroundZh: 调查追问按小时付费如何影响临床决策和家庭意愿，包括入学安排。这是对激励机制的报道，不是调整儿童治疗的建议。
argumentEn: Payment systems can reward volume even when the goal is individual benefit.
Following the same patients across providers strengthens the comparison, but does not remove every confounder.
Clinical outcomes, severity and family preferences must be assessed alongside billing.
argumentZh: 即使目标是个体获益，支付制度仍可能奖励服务数量。
追踪同一患者在不同机构的变化加强了比较，但没有消除所有混杂因素。
临床结局、病情严重度和家庭意愿须与账单一起评估。
topics.evidenceEn: Administrative claims, documents and interviews provide unusually strong triangulation. The data omit private-insurance claims and do not establish treatment quality or causation. The report includes providers’ objections, including that more severe cases need longer care; those responses are material, not decorative balance.
topics.evidenceZh: 行政账单、文件和采访形成较强的交叉验证。数据不含私人保险账单，也不能确立治疗质量或因果关系。报道保留机构关于重症需要更长治疗等反驳，这些回应影响结论，不只是形式平衡。
topics.why: 治疗机构的收入激励可能改变儿童接受服务的时长；家庭和支付方需要辨别收费增长与实际疗效。
topics.limits: 不能据此推断所有ABA治疗无效，也不能据此判断任何具体儿童应接受多少小时治疗。

topics.title: Care homes were given ‘opposite of protective ring’, Covid report finds
topics.titleZh: 养老院问责：从调查结论走向可执行保障
topics.author: The Guardian reporting team; Jessica Murray (analysis)
topics.summaryEn: Heather Hallett’s inquiry criticised the protection of care-home residents during Covid, including inadequate isolation guidance, protective equipment and restrictions that separated people from dying relatives. It recommended better planning, support for staff isolation and a presumption in favour of visits except in exceptional circumstances. Bereaved families welcomed the record of failures but questioned whether the recommendations were strong enough.
topics.summaryZh: 希瑟·哈利特主持的调查批评疫情期间对养老院居民的保护，包括隔离指引不足、防护装备欠缺，以及阻止亲人与临终家人见面的限制。建议包括改善规划、支持员工隔离，并以允许探视为原则、极端情形为例外。遗属认可对失误的记录，但质疑建议是否足够有力。
topics.backgroundEn: The deaths discussed occurred during the pandemic. The current event is publication of a new inquiry report and the debate over implementation, not a new outbreak.
topics.backgroundZh: 所讨论的死亡发生于疫情期间。当下事件是新调查报告发布及落实争论，不是新一轮疫情。
argumentEn: Protecting hospitals cannot substitute for protecting care residents.
Restrictions have social and emotional costs as well as infection-control aims.
An inquiry’s value depends on changes implemented after publication.
argumentZh: 保护医院不能代替保护照护机构居民。
限制措施除防疫目标之外，也有社会和情感成本。
调查的价值取决于发布后是否落实改变。
topics.evidenceEn: The news cites findings and recommendations; the accompanying analysis brings in bereaved families’ criticism. An inquiry is not a criminal verdict. The report distinguishes the need to free hospital beds from failures to give appropriate isolation advice.
topics.evidenceZh: 新闻引述调查发现和建议，配套分析加入遗属批评。公共调查不是刑事判决。报告区分释放医院床位的需要与未提供恰当隔离建议的失误。
topics.why: 问责若止于报告，照护体系的协调缺口就可能保留；责任与资源是否到位，比承诺本身更重要。
topics.limits: 对未来改革是否有效尚无结果，不能把政府承诺当成已完成整改。

topics.title: The good and the (not) great
topics.titleZh: 影评人与观众，真的越来越远吗？
topics.author: The Economist data and culture teams
topics.summaryEn: Using two decades of Metacritic reviews for more than 10,000 films, the analysis finds a period of divergence followed by renewed agreement between audiences and critics. They differ substantially in which films they choose to review. Genre and franchise fatigue may help explain earlier gaps, but the data do not establish one definitive cause. Critics can add context even when they do not predict personal enjoyment.
topics.summaryZh: 分析使用Metacritic一万多部电影、二十年的评论，发现观众与影评人的意见先分化、后重新趋同。双方在选择评论哪些影片方面差异明显。类型和系列电影疲劳可能解释早前分歧，但数据不能确立唯一原因。即使无法预测个人观影乐趣，评论仍能补充理解。
topics.backgroundEn: Viral examples of extreme disagreement can exaggerate a general divide. The article tests that impression against a broader sample and avoids Rotten Tomatoes because its audience methodology changed in 2019.
topics.backgroundZh: 极端分歧的热门案例可能夸大整体鸿沟。文章以更大样本检验这种印象，并因烂番茄2019年改变观众评分方法而未采用其数据。
argumentEn: Compare like with like before claiming a cultural split.
Online reviewers are selected participants, not a random audience sample.
A review’s value includes interpretation, not just recommendation.
argumentZh: 断言文化分裂前，先比较可比对象。
网络评分者是自选参与者，不是随机观众样本。
评论的价值还在解释，而不只在推荐。
topics.evidenceEn: A large longitudinal sample is stronger than selected anecdotes. Correlation between scores or box office does not prove critics cause ticket sales. Proposed explanations such as franchise fatigue remain partly interpretive.
topics.evidenceZh: 大规模纵向样本强于挑选个案。评分或票房的相关性不能证明影评导致售票变化。系列疲劳等解释仍含推断。
topics.why: 影评与观众评价的差距会影响文化产品的传播；区分口味差异与评价偏见，有助于判断权威意见。
topics.limits: 评分平台无法代表所有观众，也不衡量作品全部艺术价值。

topics.title: Service unavailable
topics.titleZh: 漏洞发现更快，防守能跟上吗？
topics.author: The Economist science and technology team
topics.summaryEn: A cluster of security incidents forced defenders to react rapidly, including critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting widely used web software. Some sites were taken offline and exploit details circulated before a promised patch. AI-assisted discovery can improve defence while accelerating pressure on maintainers. The central issue is coordinating disclosure, fixes and adoption—not assuming that discovery automatically makes systems safer.
topics.summaryZh: 包括广泛使用的PHP软件严重漏洞在内的一系列安全事件，迫使防守者迅速应对。部分网站下线，利用细节在承诺补丁发布前流传。AI辅助发现既可能改善防御，也加快维护者承受的压力。核心问题是协调披露、修复和部署，而不是假定发现漏洞自动让系统更安全。
topics.backgroundEn: Shared software creates shared exposure: a flaw in a common component can matter far beyond a single vendor. The reporting describes several distinct incidents, which should not be merged into one attack.
topics.backgroundZh: 共享软件带来共享风险：通用组件的漏洞影响可远超单一厂商。报道涉及多个不同事件，不能合并为同一场攻击。
argumentEn: Finding a vulnerability is only the first step in protection.
Disclosure timing changes the balance between defenders and attackers.
Maintenance capacity is a public-interest concern.
argumentZh: 发现漏洞只是防护的第一步。
披露时点改变攻守双方的时间优势。
维护能力是公共利益问题。
topics.evidenceEn: The report describes a disclosure timeline and emergency responses, supported by parallel newspaper coverage. It does not provide an independently verified total of compromised systems. No exploit instructions are reproduced here.
topics.evidenceZh: 报道给出披露时间线及紧急响应，并有日报平行报道。它没有提供独立核验的受侵系统总数。这里不复述漏洞利用方法。
topics.why: 网络服务依赖共同的软件基础，单点漏洞可能跨机构扩散，影响支付、通信与公共服务连续性。
topics.limits: 漏洞暴露、攻击尝试与成功入侵必须严格区分。

commentary.titleEn: Ignore the doomsayers. American democracy is in good shape
commentary.titleZh: 美国民主的韧性是否被低估？
commentary.author: Frances E. Lee
commentary.authorRole: Professor of politics and public affairs, Princeton University
commentary.position: 制度韧性论：承认规范受损，但反对把民主倒退等同于选举制度已经失效。
commentary.thesisEn: Lee argues that fixed election dates, decentralised administration and politicians’ separate electoral interests still constrain presidential power. Her claim concerns institutional resilience, not the absence of intimidation or democratic risk.
commentary.thesisZh: 李认为，固定选举日期、分散的选务管理和政治人物各自的选举利益，仍能约束总统权力。其主张是制度有韧性，而不是不存在恐吓或民主风险。
commentary.backgroundEn: The argument appears before the November 3 midterms, amid bipartisan claims about rigging. It cannot be read as a report of an election that has not happened.
commentary.backgroundZh: 文章发表于11月3日期中选举之前，背景是两党关于操纵选举的争论。它不是尚未举行选举的结果报告。
caseEn: Past midterms have often penalised the president’s party.
Court constraints and dispersed administration limit simple routes to interference.
Most losing congressional candidates in the cited research accepted defeat.
caseZh: 历史上期中选举常使总统所在党失去席位。
法院约束和分散管理限制了直接干预路径。
所引研究中，多数落败国会候选人承认失败。
commentary.evidenceEn: Historical patterns and research on 884 congressional races support the resilience claim, but are not a guarantee about 2026. Lee also notes deteriorating commitment to losers’ consent among activists.
commentary.evidenceZh: 历史模式和884场国会竞选研究支持韧性论，却不能保证2026年的结果。李也提到活动人士对接受败选原则的承诺减弱。
commentary.value: 提供与灾难叙事不同、可被经验检验的制度视角。
commentary.challenge: 过去制度成功运作，不能排除新的行政干预手段；选务正常也不等于所有民主权利健全。
commentary.takeaway: 把制度保护机制和具体受侵风险分开检查，不以乐观或悲观代替证据。

commentary.titleZh: 欧洲中间派的危机，不只是传播失败
commentary.author: The Economist editorial board
commentary.position: 自由主义、财政改革立场：反对移民替罪叙事，同时要求中间派对治理失败负责。
commentary.thesisEn: The editorial argues that centrist governments have lost credibility through weak growth and ineffective government, and that blaming immigration evades those failures. It calls for a credible reform agenda rather than defensive coalition-building alone.
commentary.thesisZh: 社论认为，中间派政府因增长疲弱和治理无效丧失信誉，归罪移民是在回避这些失败。它要求可信的改革方案，而不只是防守式联合。
commentary.backgroundEn: The argument follows French riots and wider European discontent. Its warning about future elections is a political judgment, not an established outcome.
commentary.backgroundZh: 文章回应法国骚乱及欧洲更广泛不满。关于未来选举的警告属于政治判断，不是已确定结果。
caseEn: Economic stagnation undermines promises of a better future.
Public-order failures can strengthen anti-establishment rivals.
A defensible centre must offer policies, not merely denounce extremes.
caseZh: 经济停滞削弱对更好未来的承诺。
公共秩序失灵可能壮大反建制对手。
站得住脚的中间派要提供政策，而不只谴责极端势力。
commentary.evidenceEn: The editorial draws on reporting, debt-market pressure and polls. Those observations do not uniquely identify a policy remedy; fiscal reform is its normative preference.
commentary.evidenceZh: 社论援引报道、债市压力和民调。这些观察并不能唯一确定政策解法，财政改革是其规范性偏好。
commentary.value: 提醒读者区分反对极端政治与证明现有政府有效。
commentary.challenge: 将危机主要归于改革不足，可能低估紧缩的分配成本及公共服务需求。
commentary.takeaway: 评估改革时同时问：能否增长、谁承担成本、如何获得授权。

commentary.titleZh: AI泡沫与主权债务，哪种风险更难承受？
commentary.author: The Economist editorial board
commentary.position: 宏观风险比较：认为主权债务失信比类似互联网泡沫的科技回调更危险。
commentary.thesisEn: The editorial argues that an AI investment bust could lower interest rates and ease some governments’ financing costs, whereas a loss of confidence in major sovereign debt could damage the system’s safe assets. It regards the latter as the greater threat.
commentary.thesisZh: 社论认为，AI投资泡沫破裂可能压低利率、缓解部分政府融资成本；主要主权债务若失去信任，则可能破坏金融体系的安全资产。它认为后者威胁更大。
commentary.backgroundEn: AI-linked credit has sold off while some government bonds have rallied. France remains exposed to its own fiscal and political problems.
commentary.backgroundZh: AI相关信用资产遭抛售之际，部分国债上涨。法国仍受自身财政和政治问题影响。
caseEn: Different shocks need not push every asset in the same direction.
A technology slowdown can reduce competition for capital.
A sufficiently deep recession could nevertheless combine the risks.
caseZh: 不同冲击不一定使所有资产同向变化。
技术投资放缓可能减少对资本的争夺。
足够深的衰退仍可能令两类风险叠加。
commentary.evidenceEn: The argument uses market movements and historical analogy with the dotcom bust. Its assumptions about inflation, central banks and safe-haven demand are conditional, not laws.
commentary.evidenceZh: 论证运用市场变动及互联网泡沫类比。关于通胀、央行和避险需求的假设具有条件性，并非规律保证。
commentary.value: 把‘风险很多’细化为传导机制不同的情景。
commentary.challenge: 战争通胀可能限制降息，债务链也可能比类比设想更脆弱。
commentary.takeaway: 关注冲击经由利率、税收和信用如何传导，不把标题当作投资指令。
